title: Play page simulates Game 6 of a series it says is already over
what_happened: The Play page shows NBA Finals 2026, Game 6: SAS @ NYK, with championship odds NYK 100.0% and the line NYK lead 4-1. A 4-1 lead means the series is finished, so a Game 6 simulation in October makes no sense to me. It is also labeled MONTA CARLO.
expected: Something current, or a clear note that this is an old example, and no typo in the heading

title: The leaderboard is only linked from the small footer
what_happened: I tried Play and Predict looking for the standings. The only link to a leaderboard I found is a small footer link next to Terms and Privacy on the Predict page.
expected: The standings linked from the top menu or the home page, where a player would look first

title: Predict says no games on the board in the middle of football season
what_happened: Predict says No games on the board right now and Check back at tip-off, on October 15, when football is being played every week.
expected: This week's games to pick, or a date when the next set opens

title: The leaderboard is empty: 0 participants, No data available
what_happened: After a spinner, the leaderboard shows 0 Total Participants and No data available for All Time, with Last updated today. My cousin says he is top of the board, but there is no board to see.
expected: A ranking of players with positions and points, or a plain sentence saying the board is only visible to signed-in players or that the season has not started

title: Leaderboard page loses the top menu and shows a different header
what_happened: On the leaderboard the top bar has only the logo and a Sign In button; the Learn, Predict and Play links are gone and the button is spelled Sign In instead of Sign in. It felt like I had left the site.
expected: The same header and menu on every page

title: Leaderboard filter tabs are bare icons
what_happened: Four tabs at the top of the leaderboard are only icons: a target, a speedometer, a calendar and a trophy. I could not tell what any of them would change.
expected: Short text labels on the tabs
